name: liberland-christmas-gala
description: Liberland Grand Christmas Gala 2026 — event landing page

scripts.build: tsc -b && npm run build:en && npm run build:zh
scripts.build:en: vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.build:zh: VITE_LANG=zh vite build --outDir dist/zh && VITE_LANG=zh vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr-zh && VITE_LANG=zh node scripts/prerender.mjs
